purpose: Machine-readable handoff from the ICVL acquisition work package to Codex/M3. States exactly what M3 must configure, what was verified, and what was NOT decided here.

m3_integration.why_this_path: m3_pipeline.source_records() enumerates *.mat inside the directory given by local_icvl_dir, validates each filename against the official catalog and each size against catalog[filename]['size'], then counts them. It needs the directory that CONTAINS the .mat files.
m3_integration.note_do_not_do: This work package does NOT edit config_m3.json. Codex/M3 owns that file. It was verified to still have local_icvl_dir = null.

rad_layout_warning.indices_source: value matching against each file's own bands array; never a hardcoded slice
rad_layout_warning.warning: M3 must NOT assume (H, W, C) axis order and must NOT assume a constant width. Read the actual shape per scene. rad_shape_stored in icvl_hdf5_audit.json is recorded exactly as stored, never transposed.

verified_interface_agreement.meaning: M3's catalog and this work package's independent API fetch agree exactly, so the size-based validation M3 performs is consistent with the manifest produced here.

what_this_work_package_verified_beyond_m.m3_checks: filename present in official catalog + file size equals catalog size
additional_here: SHA256 of every file computed from the bytes on disk
SHA256 compared against the repository's own declared LFS oid: 202/202 matched, 0 mismatched
rad_shape_stored recorded exactly as stored, never transposed
actual wavelength values read and checked strictly increasing: 202/202
420-660 nm / 25 target bands verified, indices derived by value matching: 202/202
cloud-placeholder / read-failure detection on the Google Drive mount: 0 problems
post-audit re-hash proved the audit was read-only
what_this_work_package_verified_beyond_m.note: Size-only validation cannot detect a same-size corrupted file; the SHA256 layer here can, and it is now anchored to the repository's own published digests.

deliberately_not_done_by_this_work_packa: no selection of the formal 150-scene subset (no random / first-N / speed-based / content-based choice)
no reading of any sealed test set for prediction or metrics
no modification of the M2 operator package
no modification of M1 GPU environment
no modification of M3 source or results
scene_split_note: All 202 scenes were downloaded in full. Scene names are visible in mat/ (e.g. Lehavim_*, nachal_*, objects_*, negev_*). This work package did NOT use them to select anything. All split and subset decisions belong to Codex/M3 per task doc sections 12.2 and 23.

storage_caveat_for_m3.meaning: G: and H: are two account labels over ONE volume and share a single pool of free space. Treating them as independent storage, or falling back to the other letter when one looks full, is invalid on this host.
storage_caveat_for_m3.recommendation_for_cache: M3 keeps its <=512 MiB per-scene cache on D: as section 22 requires; D: had 121.27 GiB free when measured, so the cache is not space-constrained.

environment_notes.proxy_required: HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY must be set explicitly to http://127.0.0.1:7897 for huggingface_hub/httpx and pip on this host. Without it, TLS handshake fails and the error is easily misread as a network fault.
environment_notes.gated_repo_redacts_oids_when_anonymous: huggingface.co returns lfs.oid as 64 asterisks for anonymous requests to a gated repo, without any error. Any tooling that reads the tree must authenticate or its digest comparison becomes vacuous. fetch_pinned_tree.py refuses to write a tree whose digests are redacted.

concurrent_activity_note: Codex/M3 was observed running its own parallel acquisition during this work package (work/m3_parallel_acquisition_20261007.log), downloading HARVARD data (CZ_hsdb, CZ_hsdbi, scene0*_reflectance), not ICVL. There is no data conflict. Bandwidth is shared, so the ICVL download used --max-workers 2 to limit contention as task doc section 6 requires.
